resources.string: PullDock downloads BitTorrent transfers and authorized media from supported providers, manages both in one queue, and plays finished media in-app. It does not search for or index content.
Everything stays on this device: your downloads, your library, your settings. PullDock has no accounts, no analytics, and no upload path.
BitTorrent transfers connect directly to other peers. During a torrent transfer, your IP address is visible to those peers — this is how the protocol works and cannot be avoided while transferring.
You are responsible for downloading only content you have the right to download. PullDock does not bypass DRM, paywalls, login walls, or private accounts, and it will not attempt to.

Notifications: progress and control of running downloads (Android 13+, optional — the app works without it). File access is handled through the system file picker and scoped storage only. No clipboard reading, no location, no contacts.
